faqs.q: Sec. 42-36. - I.F.C. Section 105.7, Required construction permits.
faqs.a:
Section 105.7 Required construction permits
, the following subsection is added as follows:
"105.7.26 Temporary fire apparatus access roads.
A construction permit is required for the installation of a temporary fire apparatus
                  access road when used in lieu of an approved surface per Section 503.2.3 and Chapter
                  33."
(Ord. No.
4739
, § 3, 9-14-2020)
